title: PMSV FSSAI Labelling & Display Rule Core

source_policy.fail_closed_rule: A product-specific label declaration is shown only when an exact verified product rule is loaded. Similar product names are not used to infer warnings or declarations.

current_source.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
current_source.title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Compendium Version VIII (09.09.2025)

future_amendment.title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
future_amendment.rule: Do not apply the 2026 amendment before 1 July 2027.

general_prepackaged_rules.title: Net quantity, retail sale price and consumer care

product_specific_rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

declarations.text: Not recommended for children, pregnant or lactating women, persons sensitive to caffeine.
Consume not more than 500 ml per day

ingredient_threshold_rules.declaration_short: Contains Isomaltulose — energy per 100 g or 100 ml must be declared
Special sorbitol laxative/bloating/diarrhea and calcium-absorption warning required

individual_warning_summaries.polyols: Polyol-specific declaration applies; threshold-based laxative warning is assessed separately.

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Treated maida requires the prescribed bakery-only declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Was this maida treated with an improver or bleaching agent?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Dried glucose syrup above the specified sulphur-dioxide condition requires the prescribed confectionery-use declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: What is the sulphur dioxide level in the dried glucose syrup (ppm)?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Fruit squash with additional sodium or potassium salt requires the corresponding added-salt declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Does this fruit squash contain additional sodium or potassium salt?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Flavour emulsion/paste for beverage use requires the prescribed beverage-only declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this flavour emulsion/paste intended for carbonated or non-carbonated beverages?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Wax-coated cheese requires the prescribed instruction to remove the coating before consumption.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this cheese coated or packed in food-grade wax?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Frozen dessert/confection requires the prescribed declaration identifying edible vegetable oil and/or vegetable fat as applicable.

qualifier_ui.question: Confirm that the selected standardized product is the frozen dessert/frozen confection article covered by this rule.

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Common Salt requires the prescribed intended-use declaration, retaining the applicable purpose(s) and striking out the others.

qualifier_ui.question: Select every intended use that applies to this Common Salt package.

options.label: Preservation — not meant for direct consumption

qualifier_ui.presentation_note: Strike out every purpose that is not applicable.

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Wax-coated fresh fruit requires a declaration naming the wax.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this fresh fruit coated with wax?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Gelatin intended for human consumption requires the food-grade declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this gelatin intended for human consumption?

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: Refined vegetable oil must carry the prescribed refined-oil name declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Confirm that the selected standardized product is refined vegetable oil covered by this declaration.

article_specific_rules.requirement_summary: One-time plastic bottles require the current prescribed bottle-disposal declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this water packed in a one-time usable plastic bottle?

ingredient_presence_rules.requirement_summary: Added monosodium glutamate requires the prescribed contains-MSG declaration and the applicable infant/pregnancy warning.
Added plant stanol esters trigger the prescribed content, medical-supervision, population-suitability and daily-intake declarations.
ingredient_presence_rules.runtime_note: Do not trigger on ingredient presence alone; use schedule_ii.product_ingredient_rules plant_stanol_esters with eligible-product gating.

schedule_ii.qualifier_runtime_policy: Conditional article declarations activate only after the stored qualifier evaluates true. Unanswered, false, unsupported or ambiguous qualifiers remain fail-closed.

article_warning_rules.requirement_summary: Pan Masala must carry the prescribed chewing-health warning; the warning statement must cover 50% of the front-of-pack label.
Supari must carry the prescribed chewing-health warning.

product_ingredient_rules.requirement_summary: Eligible products containing added plant stanol esters require the prescribed Plant Stanol content, medical-supervision, population-suitability and maximum-daily-consumption declarations.
Where trehalose is added to an eligible listed food, the label must carry the prescribed Contains Trehalose declaration.

eligible_product_terms: ready to eat dry breakfast cereal
product_ingredient_rules.declaration_short: Contains Dietary Fibre (Dextrin) — source of soluble dietary fibre
product_ingredient_rules.requirement_summary: Eligible foods containing added Dietary Fibre (Dextrin-soluble fibre) require the prescribed source-of-soluble-dietary-fibre declaration.
Eligible products containing added plant sterol require the prescribed phytosterol content, medical-supervision, population-suitability and maximum-daily-consumption declarations.

qualifier_ui.question: Has this food been treated with ionizing radiation?

universal_process_rules.requirement_summary: Irradiated food requires a treatment statement near the food name and, where processed under regulation 2.13, the green Radura logo plus the prescribed radiation-processing particulars.

coverage_status.note: Schedule II paragraph 1 ingredient thresholds, paragraph 2 article rules, paragraph 3 Pan Masala/Supari warnings, paragraph 4 sweetener/MSG rules, paragraphs 5-6 oil/water article rules, paragraphs 7-10 plant stanol/trehalose/dextrin/plant sterol rules, and paragraph 11 irradiation are represented. Specific manner-of-labelling rules beginning at section 2 are a separate next module.

allergen_rules.gluten_exemption_note: Do not auto-approve the exemption from the ingredient name alone; the applicable safety/gluten condition must be verified.
allergen_rules.sulphite_note: The 10 mg/kg threshold is based on sulphur dioxide content. Direct sulphur dioxide can be assessed from formulation mass; sulphite salts require SO2-equivalent verification.

specific_manner_rules.source_clause: Schedule II · 2. Specific requirements / restrictions on manner of labelling

sections_2_1_to_2_5.requirement_summary: Edible refined vegetable oils and fats must not use exaggerated refining expressions such as Super-Refined, Extra-Refined, Micro-Refined, Double Refined or Ultra-Refined.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage by weight of this Vanaspati is Rice Bran Oil?

sections_2_1_to_2_5.requirement_summary: Vanaspati made from more than 30% Rice Bran Oil must carry the prescribed more-than-30%-rice-bran-oil declaration.
If physically refined Rice Bran Oil is used in Vanaspati, it must be declared in the ingredient list as Physically Refined Rice Bran Oil.
Vegetable oil containing annatto colour must carry the prescribed Contains Annatto colour declaration.
Multi-source edible oil requires the prescribed front-of-pack product name, each oil name/nature and percentage by weight, pack-size-dependent minimum lettering, and NOT TO BE SOLD LOOSE.
Coffee–Chicory Mixture must carry the current front-of-package coffee/chicory percentage declaration.
Instant Coffee–Chicory Mixture must carry the current front-of-package declaration identifying the blend and coffee/chicory percentages.

Milk powders, skimmed milk powders and condensed milk or similar products that can be reconstituted into liquid milk must carry the prescribed warning that they are not to be used for infants below six months.

Packaged/mineral drinking water labels must not make medicinal or other health-benefit claims; locality names are restricted; statements or pictorial devices must not mislead about nature, origin, composition or properties.
For products under the Gluten Free standard, the term Gluten Free must appear in immediate proximity to the product name.

qualifier_ui.question: Is this gluten-free product manufactured in a plant where gluten-containing products are also manufactured?

sections_2_1_to_2_5.requirement_summary: A gluten-free product made in a plant where gluten-containing products are also manufactured requires the prescribed shared-plant declaration.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is whole wheat flour (Atta)?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Whole Wheat Bread requires whole wheat flour (Atta) at not less than 75% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is whole wheat flour (Atta)?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Wheat Bread / Brown Bread requires whole wheat flour (Atta) at not less than 50% of the flour basis.
White Bread is the nomenclature row associated with refined wheat flour (Maida); the table specifies no minimum specialty-ingredient percentage.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is made up of permitted grains other than wheat?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Multigrain Bread requires at least 20% permitted grains other than wheat on the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is milk solids?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Milk Bread requires milk solids at not less than 6% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is honey?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Honey Bread requires honey at not less than 5% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is cheese?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Cheese Bread requires cheese at not less than 10% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is oats?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Oatmeal Bread requires oats at not less than 15% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is cracked wheat / Dhalia?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Cracked Wheat / Dhalia Bread requires cracked wheat / Dhalia at not less than 15% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is wheat germ?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Bread with Wheat Germ requires wheat germ at not less than 2% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is edible whole egg solids?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Egg Bread requires edible whole egg solids at not less than 1.5% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is candied fruit?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Fruit Bread / Loaf requires candied fruit at not less than 10% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is triticale flour?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Triticale Bread requires triticale flour at not less than 20% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is rye flour?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Rye Bread requires rye flour at not less than 20% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is raisins?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Raisin Bread requires raisins at not less than 10% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is edible bran?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Bran Bread requires edible bran at not less than 5% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is edible protein?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Protein-enriched / Protein Prachur Bread requires edible protein at not less than 15% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is the named specialty ingredient (for example garlic, masala or oregano)?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Garlic / Masala / Oregano and similar named specialty breads require the named specialty ingredient at not less than 2% of the flour basis.

qualifier_ui.question: What percentage of the flour basis is the named seed ingredient?

bread_rules.requirement_summary: Bread with seeds such as flax, sesame or pumpkin seeds requires the named seed ingredient at not less than 5% of the flour basis.

specific_manner_rules.bread_source_note: Specialty-ingredient percentages are assessed on a 100 g flour basis, as specified in Schedule II section 2.6.

flour_basis_runtime.denominator_policy: Sum formulation ingredients whose normalized name contains 'flour', plus exact Atta and Maida identities.
flour_basis_runtime.fail_closed_rule: Automatic assessment is used only when the flour basis is greater than zero and at least one exact numerator alias is present. Otherwise PMSV keeps the numeric qualifier available for manual verified input.
